# AppButton

The one button: a capsule with a colour role (variant), a visual weight (appearance) and a size — the same three axes as Badge.

`NomNom.AppButton` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.AppButton />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.AppButton"></x-import>
```

## Props (AppButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | Or pass as children. With `iconOnly` it becomes the accessible name. |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'destructive' \| 'pro' \| 'reaction'` | 'reaction' only inside rating controls (TasteScoreSelector). @default 'primary' |
| `reaction` | `'inedible' \| 'bad' \| 'meh' \| 'good' \| 'great' \| 'amazing'` | With variant 'reaction'. |
| `appearance` | `'solid' \| 'soft' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost' \| 'elevated'` | @default 'solid' |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Heights spacing-9 / 11 / 12 (36 / 44 / 48). @default 'md' |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |
| `iconPosition` | `'start' \| 'end'` | @default 'start' |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | Circle as wide as it is tall; `label` is required. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Spinner in the icon slot, button disabled, aria-busy. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` |  |
